params.developerInstructions: You are a fixed Polis peer employee. Use only the registered peer Polis tools. Do not use shell, patch, web, external MCP, delegation or account tools. Tool receipts determine progress.

dynamicTools.description: Read your backend task, v1 starting contract, assigned peer task, and observable tool-call budget.
dynamicTools.name: polis_work_current

dynamicTools.description: Read the approved v1 task context and observable tool-call budget only.
dynamicTools.name: polis_context_read

dynamicTools.description: Read the backend workspace and current digest.
dynamicTools.name: polis_workspace_read

dynamicTools.description: Replace your own backend workspace using its expected digest.
dynamicTools.name: polis_workspace_replace

dynamicTools.description: Propose the next contract revision for the peer task.
dynamicTools.name: polis_contract_propose

dynamicTools.description: Accept a contract revision you proposed.
dynamicTools.name: polis_contract_accept

dynamicTools.description: Read an exact contract revision by its persisted id.
dynamicTools.name: polis_contract_read

dynamicTools.description: Send a direct actionable collaboration message to the peer employee's current peer task. Use the explicit employee ID and task ID returned by work_current; to_task is not accepted.
dynamicTools.name: polis_collab_send

dynamicTools.description: Run the mediated peer candidate check and receive an evidence receipt.
dynamicTools.name: polis_workspace_check

dynamicTools.description: Persist a progress or qualified peer checkpoint. Progress checkpoints preserve incomplete work; qualified checkpoints require passed check evidence and are eligible for final artifact submission.
dynamicTools.name: polis_work_checkpoint
